data.narrative:
Firma Power is a seed-stage company in the Climate & Energy sector. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (Lonza Group, ticker LNZA), though the peer set lacks sufficient granularity for traditional benchmarking. Top private comparables include Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen, representing a range of technology maturity and capital intensity within the sector.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. The Climate & Energy peer universe, while containing 9 firms, yields zero same-stage matches, zero adjacent-stage matches, and zero similar-valuation-tier matches—all three filters fall below the minimum threshold of three datapoints required for reliable triangulation. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given the wide dispersion in stage, capital requirements, and revenue profiles across the broader climate tech landscape.

Without sufficient narrow-peer density, this analysis cannot support a triangulated valuation range grounded in comparable company methodology. Any forward valuation would require either: (1) obtaining capital-round data from the identified private peers to construct a seed-stage subset; (2) deploying discounted cash flow or cost-of-capital methods if sufficient financial projections are available; or (3) benchmarking against broader climate-tech funding patterns. The primary uncertainty remains the absence of granular seed-stage comp data in this sector.
